content: Android 14+ requires manifest foregroundServiceType + matching FOREGROUND_SERVICE_* permission per service (developer.android.com/develop/background-work/services/fgs/service-types). dataProcessing type exists for work-profile data processing with FOREGROUND_SERVICE_DATA_PROCESSING. If POST_NOTIFICATIONS denied, FGS keeps running and the Task Manager indicator shows but the progress notification is hidden. Background FGS starts restricted (BAL/while-in-use).
